# RDH Robotics

> RDH Robotics designs and manufactures purpose-built hardware for Cyber Tools, embedded systems, educational pentesting platforms, IoT telemetry, and SCADA automation based in India. Founded by Rajbhar Divesh.

Official Website: https://rdhrobotics.in
Documentation: https://docs.rdhrobotics.in
Web Flasher Tool: https://flasher.rdhrobotics.in
GitHub: https://github.com/rdhrobotics
Contact: rdhrobotics@hotmail.com / support@rdhrobotics.in

## Core Products & Hardware

### 1. RF Hunter
- **Category**: Standalone Wireless Security Research Platform
- **URL**: https://rdhrobotics.in/products/rf-hunter
- **Documentation**: https://docs.rdhrobotics.in/docs/RF-Hunter
- **Pricing**: From ₹1,899 INR (Fully Assembled: ₹1,899 | Assembled + Case: ₹1,999)
- **Key Hardware Specifications**:
  - MCU: ESP8266 @ 80/160 MHz with 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi
  - RF Transceiver: nRF24L01+ PA+LNA for extended range 2.4 GHz operations
  - IR Module: TSOP 1838 38 kHz Infrared transmitter and receiver (emulate & capture remotes)
  - Display: 1.3" OLED Display (128x64)
  - Input: 6-button physical keypad navigation
  - Storage: Onboard EEPROM with 5-slot credential vault surviving power cycles
  - Battery: 600 mAh 3.7V Li-Polymer with integrated charging circuit via USB-C
  - Interface: Dual interface - standalone OLED UI and simultaneous built-in web admin panel (default: 192.168.4.1)
  - Firmware: Open source, Arduino/ESP8266 toolchain
- **Modules**:
  - Jammer: nRF24 constant carrier jammer for BLE + all 2.4 GHz or Wi-Fi channels only
  - Deauther Suite: Powered by spacehuhn deauther engine (Scan, select, deauth, beacon flood, probe attack)
  - WiPhi: Deauth + EvilTwin + captive portal credential harvester with EEPROM vault
  - Infrared: 38 kHz IR transmitter and receiver
- **Use Cases**: Wireless security auditing, protocol experimentation, RF education, authorized laboratory testing.

### 2. USB D-Byte
- **Category**: RP2040 Development Board for HID Automation & Embedded Prototyping
- **URL**: https://rdhrobotics.in/products/usb-d-byte
- **Documentation**: https://docs.rdhrobotics.in/docs/USB-D-Byte/
- **Pricing**: From ₹849 INR (4MB: ₹849 | 8MB: ₹999 | 16MB: ₹1,099)
- **Key Hardware Specifications**:
  - Processor: Raspberry Pi RP2040 Dual-core 32-bit ARM Cortex-M0+ @ 133 MHz
  - Form Factor: Ultra-compact USB-A thumb drive format (47mm × 18mm × 8mm)
  - Storage: Up to 16MB SPI Flash
  - Mode Switch: 2-position hardware switch (Attack & Setup modes)
  - Controls: Dedicated Reset & Boot pushbuttons for instant UF2 flashing
  - Capabilities: Emulates USB HID keyboard, mouse, mass storage, and custom USB descriptors
- **Use Cases**: System administration automation, keystroke injection simulation in authorized labs, micro-controller education, compact IoT firmware prototyping.

## Online Utilities & Tools

- **Web Flasher**: https://flasher.rdhrobotics.in - Browser-based WebSerial firmware flashing tool for RDH devices (ESP8266, RP2040) without requiring command-line installations.
- **Documentation Hub**: https://docs.rdhrobotics.in - Detailed schematics, quick-start guides, pinout diagrams, firmware source code, and release notes.

## Company & Mission

RDH Robotics was founded in India by Rajbhar Divesh to provide transparent, accessible, open-specification hardware for technical teams, security researchers, educators, and industrial engineers. RDH products prioritize open documentation, practical firmware, and repeatable learning rather than proprietary black boxes.
